A must try Banh Mi in Hanoi
Jul 2025 • Couples
Some of the 3/4 star reviews are a bit disappointing. If you don’t like queues, order food off grab. If you want extra fillings ask for extra fillings, there’s literally a menu option for that. 

We waited about 10 mins for our Bahn MI’s and it was worth the wait. They were super nice when ordering. 
The bread looked a bit flat but when you bite into it, it’s crunchy on the outside while soft on the inside exactly how a crusty dough style of bread should be. The bread was super fresh, if I was to guess I would say it was baked less than 3 hrs before hand. 

Getting the sausage pork and egg with pate was definitely a great choice, the flavour in the Bahn Mi was amazing. I told them to make sure it had all salad and it was a great serve!

I was told the North doesn’t do Bahn Mi’s as well as the south, but after today I disagree!!
